questions.q: If the LMP was 10 January, the expected date of delivery is about:
questions.why: 10 Jan + 9 months + 7 days = 17 October

questions.q: Preeclampsia is hypertension after 20 weeks with:
questions.why: Proteinuria (300 mg/24 h) or end-organ involvement

questions.q: In India, gestational diabetes is diagnosed (DIPSI) when the 2-hour glucose after 75 g is:
questions.why: DIPSI single-step 75 g test, 2-hour value 140 mg/dL

questions.q: The second stage of labour ends with:
questions.why: 2nd stage = full dilatation to delivery of the baby

questions.q: Painless, recurrent, bright red bleeding in the third trimester suggests:
questions.why: Praevia is painless; abruptio is painful

questions.q: Primary dysmenorrhoea is defined as painful menstruation:
questions.why: No pelvic pathology; prostaglandin-mediated

questions.q: In the PALM-COEIN classification, "L" stands for:
questions.why: PALM = polyp, adenomyosis, leiomyoma, malignancy

questions.q: Polycystic ovarian syndrome is diagnosed by the Rotterdam criteria when present are:
questions.why: Any 2 of anovulation, hyperandrogenism, polycystic ovaries

questions.q: The most important long-term complication of pelvic inflammatory disease is:
questions.why: Tubal damage: infertility and ectopic pregnancy

questions.q: Bearing-down sensation with indifference to family and better from vigorous exercise suggests:
questions.why: Sepia keynotes

questions.q: A child usually sits without support at:
questions.why: Sits without support 6–8 months

questions.q: Jaundice appearing on the first day of life is:
questions.why: Jaundice within 24 hours is always pathological

questions.q: The anterior fontanelle closes by:
questions.why: Anterior 12–18 months; posterior 2–3 months

questions.q: Oedema with flaky-paint skin and a fatty liver in a malnourished child indicates:
questions.why: Oedema = kwashiorkor

questions.q: Exclusive breastfeeding is recommended for the first:
questions.why: 6 months, then complementary feeding

questions.q: Which vaccines are given at birth under the UIP?
questions.why: BCG, OPV-0, Hep B birth dose

questions.q: The first dose of measles–rubella vaccine is given at:
questions.why: MR-1 at 9–12 months, MR-2 at 16–24 months

questions.q: Enuresis is diagnosed only after the age of:
questions.why: Bladder control is expected by 5 years

questions.q: Painful dentition in an angry child who wants to be carried, with one cheek red:
questions.why: Chamomilla keynote

questions.q: Croup with dry, barking, sawing cough better from warm drinks:
questions.why: Spongia: dry sawing croup better warm drinks
